text.p: Shares in Hungarian gas distributor company Primagaz Rt were steady on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Tuesday, after Nomura Equity Research downgraded the paper to 'hold' from 'buy'.
Primagaz stocks opened at 10,000 forints, unchanged from Monday's close. All four deals, concluded for the paper until 1102 GMT, were made at 10,000 forints/share.
In a company update, received after the bourse's close on Monday, Nomura downgraded Primagaz to 'hold' from 'buy' and reduced its earnings per share (EPS) forecast too. @

"Sales growth is now slowing, however, and although profits growth will continue we have reduced our 1997 EPS forecast from 611 forints to 558 forints," analysts Frances Cloud and Barry MacCarthy said. "On this basis we are downgrading our recommendation from buy to hold."
